$comment: The change map (scripts/changed-images.mjs): per image its Dockerfile, input globs (`**` any depth, `*` one segment, `!glob` excludes, `@image` adds that image's inputs), shared groups, argsFrom (repository files fed in as build arguments), whether it is a required check and whether `reproducible` covers it.
An image's image commit is the newest first-parent commit that touched one of its inputs. When in doubt, count more as input, never less: a missed input ships a stale image.
`exclude` applies everywhere; `.dockerignore` drops apply only to an image's own `inputs`, never to `groups`, `full` or `argsFrom`. Changing a `full` file makes the run full.

version.json is an input of the backend only: it is the one image that bakes APP_VERSION / APP_CODENAME; the other images take the version from the backend's /api/version. Every image bakes its own image commit (FF_IMAGE_COMMIT, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH = its commit time), never the run commit, so an image with the same image commit is the same image. mediaserver becomes required in Stage D.
